_comment: The verifier-owned pins for this composition template.
Every value is a digest or a checksum, never a tag; changing one needs a new directory and a new
Docker Official buildpack-deps:bookworm linux/arm64 manifest digest.
What is pinned is (a) this installer, by the sha256 below, and (b) the exact toolchain *version*,
which travels in the recipe as `pair.rsver`.
`--profile minimal` keeps the image to what a build needs; `wasm32v1-none` is the Soroban target.
The released binary, not a source build.
Shared libraries the released `stellar` binary needs and `base_image` does not supply.
The non-root user, working directory and baked toolchain environment the image runs builds under.
`bake_rustup_toolchain` fixes the toolchain in the image so submitted source cannot select its own.
